question.text:
Paragraph: The figure shows a surface $X Y$ separating two transparent media, medium-1 and medium-2. The lines $a b$ and $c d$ represent wavefronts of a light wave travelling in medium-1 and incident on $X Y$. The lines ef and $g h$ represent wavefronts of the light wave in medium-2 after refraction.
Question: Light travels as a

options.text: divergent beam in one medium and convergent beam in the other medium

solution.text: Wavefronts are parallel in both media. Therefore, light which is perpendicular to wavefront travels as a parallel beam in each medium. Hence, the correct option is (a).
